library(tidyverse)

## Functions 

Start small with Z scores 

```{r}
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec) 

```
Lets turn this into a function

```{r}
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if(!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("Input x must be numeric")
    } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
 z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x) 
 
 return(z)
 
}

# Z only exists inside this function as long as this function is working 
# X is also an argument inside the function 
# x_vec exists 
```

Does this work?

```{r}
z_scores(x_vec)
z_scores(rpois(4000, lambda = 12))

```

## Mean and Sd

```{r}
mean(x_vec)
sd(x_vec) 
```

Write a function that returns the mean and sd of an input vector 

```{r}
mean_and_sd = function(x) {
  
  return_df = 
    tibble(
      mean = mean(x),
      sd = sd(x)
      )
    
    return(return_df)
}
```

## Motivate and write another one!!

```{r}
sim_df = 
  tibble(
    x =rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 3)
  )

sim_df |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(x), 
    sd = sd(x)
  )
```
```{r}
source("Source/sim_mean_sd.R")
```

```{r}
sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 50, mu = 150, sigma = 30)

sim_mean_sd(50, 12, 3)

sim_mean_sd(150, n_obs,)
```
